title: Molten Japanese Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Japanese-inspired stir fry made with tender beef and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the wok and set aside.
In the same wok, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Add the snow peas and carrots and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the wok and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Return the beef to the wok and stir in the soy sauce, brown sugar, and cooked vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the beef is coated.
Transfer the stir fry to a serving platter and garnish with chopped green onions.
